strengths: The synthwave look is strong and consistent: a neon pink grid floor, a glowing sunset behind dark crystal spires, and magenta spotlight beams at the board corners
Bloom and glow are used well on the snake head, the food beacon and the floating cyan shapes, so the scene has real atmosphere
It is a real 3D scene: the board has a raised rim and corner posts, rings and diamonds float around it, crystal pillars give depth, and the camera angle changes between the title screen and play
The eating effect is visible in space: a ring spreads on the floor around the head and sparks fly, and the food is a golden beam that is easy to spot
The game over screen gets a camera close-up of the snake's head with eyes, a shockwave ring and a 'NEW BEST' tag; the title and game over panels look neat and on-theme
Stable to play: 13/13 checks, 0 errors, 22 foods eaten in 40 s, and it works on a phone with no scrollbars
weaknesses: During play the snake is tiny and sits far from the camera at the back of a huge board, so it reads as a few small balls and is hard to follow
The HUD labels (SCORE, BEST, LEVEL) are very dim and almost unreadable; BEST and LEVEL are crowded into the corner
Too much going on outside the board: shapes floating close to the camera, white bloom blobs and bright beams pull the eye away from the game
Snake segments are plain spheres that blend into each other; the head is only modeled in the game over close-up
On a phone the board takes up a small part of the screen and the title panel covers part of it
oneLine: A striking, stable synthwave scene with good glow and eating effects, held back by a tiny, far-away snake that is hard to read during play and a HUD you can barely see.
